followUps.title: Management escalates twice in five days over the negative survey pattern
followUps.body: Abel Eben Pienaar's 25-Aug email sets eight mandatory actions (investigation reports for negative variance, minimum 95-ton truck payload, 10% haul-road gradient cap, overspill mined within its originating period, hourly excavator BCM targets, break-duration discipline, first/last-load discipline, individual supervisor accountability) and calls a 06:30 meeting with both shifts' supervision. On 27-Aug, immediately after that day's survey posted -10.69%, Pienaar writes: "I will not accept a negative survey this month again. The line was drawn and everyone was warned." The following day posts -14.52% — a second negative reading inside 48 hours of the warning.
